title: OMMX Book 概念とページの依存台帳
scope: 日本語Bookの主要概念とページ/節の編集契約。Qamomileは後続。API全項目の網羅ではない。

baseline.note: Historical source baseline for proposed contracts; not the current main or a claim that the Book implements them. Resolve the live review revision separately.

interpretation.knowledge_unit: 概念名ではなく読者の学習成果。solution.readとevaluation.basic等を分ける。
interpretation.introduces: その節で必要な意味・操作・結果の読み方を説明し、その能力を習得できるという編集上の宣言。
interpretation.uses: 理解を前提に操作・判断・結果読解を要求する。
interpretation.mentions: 名称、見取り図、参照リンク、説明を要求しないコード/出力の露出。既習に加えない。
interpretation.requires: ページへの明示的な概念前提。単なるリンクや推奨順は代用しない。
interpretation.owner: 詳しい説明を統括する正本。唯一の初出ページや必読ページではない。
interpretation.optional_sections: 親ページと別ID。親を読んでも任意節の知識は付与しない。
interpretation.route_join: 別々の経路が合流したら保証される既知概念は共通部分。
interpretation.validation_limit: 検査は明示注釈間の整合性を調べる。自然言語本文の正確性・理解度・SDK実行は証明しない。

review_notes.note: Imported proposed contracts are not a certification of the current Book. Review the affected source and concept granularity before relying on a declared introduction.

PR #1280's reader-order correction introduces variable kinds/domains before type-specific default rules. This resolves that source-order defect by reordering, not by treating a Binary example as proof of semi-domain knowledge. The historical baseline URLs are unchanged.

The 21 initial routes are representative, not exhaustive: audit homepage-to-Guide entries as well as the declared routes. Homepage cognitive load is not covered by the set-based checker. PR #1280 reduces the homepage's unexplained transformation-name catalogue; the remaining whole-Book entry/route audit is still open.

Recheck early removed/output-objective references, named-function prerequisites, and source-observation omissions against the reviewed revision rather than treating mention annotations as accepted judgments. PR #1280 postpones and locally glosses these details in Instance/Solution/SampleSet; other Guides and the historical observation inventory remain unverified.
